## What's Changed

### Features
- Show cost breakdown toast when clicking or selecting a session in the week view dialog (`/sessions_cost`), keeping the dialog open for continued browsing instead of navigating to the session.
- Add session cache fallback for accurate cost attribution of past sessions from the week view list.
- Highlight the clicked row immediately upon mouse interaction.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/StayPirate/opencode-total-session-cost/compare/v1.3.2...v1.4.0

### Fixed

- The per-model breakdown now reads every message page instead of only the newest one, so a session past the page size no longer loses its earliest messages and reassigns that spend to the currently selected model.
- Durable events are used only when they cover the whole session cost, so a legacy session resumed on a v2 client falls back to the more complete message history.
- Cost that no step or message can explain is now reported as `unknown/unknown` instead of being guessed onto the currently selected model.

### Fixed

- Per-model cost breakdown is now rebuilt from Opencode's durable session event log, so switching model mid-session no longer attributes earlier spend (e.g. Plan mode) to the currently selected model.
- Compaction and revert no longer hide spend from the breakdown, and the model rows always sum to the real session total.

## What's Changed

### Features
- Add `/sessions_cost` (alias `/session_costs`): a centered, read-only dialog listing the sessions of the last 7 days grouped by day, with the recursive total (session + sub-agents) on each session row and the daily total on each day header. Navigate with the up/down arrows, `enter` to open a session, `esc` to close.
- Right-clicking the cost bar in the prompt header now opens the session costs list, while left-clicking still shows the detailed breakdown toast.

### Improvements
- Extract the session day-grouping logic into the pure `cost` module and cover it with tests.
- Register the TUI commands through `api.keymap.registerLayer` instead of the deprecated `api.command` API.
- Bound the session list request with the `start` query parameter.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/StayPirate/opencode-total-session-cost/compare/v1.2.1...v1.3.0
